name: SafeScript
blurb: SafeScript is a fast, clean code snippet manager for developers.
description:
SafeScript is a fast, clean code snippet manager for developers. Organize your snippets into folders, search instantly, and edit with a built-in syntax-aware code editor.

• Organize snippets into folders with drag-to-reorder

• Syntax-aware code editor with line numbers

• Dark and light mode

• Instant search across all snippets

• Notes field for each snippet

• 100% local storage — all data stays on your device

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
